mechanism: Both agents have cholinergic and adrenergic effects that may additively affect heart rate, blood pressure, and cardiac conduction; galantamine increases acetylcholine while guanfacine is an alpha-2 agonist with potential opposing cardiovascular effects.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and cardiac rhythm; use caution in patients with underlying cardiac conduction abnormalities or hemodynamic instability; dose adjustment may be necessary.
